codes:
======================================================================
NORTH CAROLINA RESIDENTIAL CODE (NCRC) - ROOF ASSEMBLY COMPLIANCE
======================================================================

[+] AHJ JURISDICTION: Buncombe County Permitting & Inspections
    - Building Permit: REQUIRED for structural re-roofing / material transition.
    - Decking Inspection: Mandatory prior to underlayment application.

[+] TECHNICAL CODE REQUIREMENTS:
    - Wind Resistance (NCRC R905.10): Fasteners must withstand local design wind
      speeds (115 mph baseline in western NC).
    - Underlayment (NCRC R905.1.1): Self-adhering polymer-modified bitumen sheet
      required at eaves and valleys (ice & water shield) where pitch <= 6/12.
    - Metal Panel Standard: Must comply with ASTM A792 (55% Al-Zn Galvalume).
phases:
======================================================================
PHASED EXECUTION: MATERIALS, TOOLS & STAGING MANIFEST
======================================================================

PHASE 1: TEAR-OFF & DEMOLITION
  [ ] Tools: Pitch hoes, roofing shovels, magnetic sweepers, tarps
  [ ] Disposal: 20-yard roll-off dumpster staged driveway-side
  [ ] Safety: OSHA harness kits, rope grabs, ridge anchor brackets

PHASE 2: DECK PREPARATION & UNDERLAYMENT
  [ ] Materials: 7/16" OSB sheathing buffer, 8d ring-shank nails
  [ ] Barriers: High-temp synthetic underlayment + ice & water shield

PHASE 3: STANDING SEAM INSTALLATION
  [ ] Metal Panels: Custom cut Galvalume 26ga standing seam
  [ ] Fasteners: #10 pancake-head concealed clip screws
  [ ] Trim: Custom bent drip edge, rake, ridge cap, butyl tape, poly sealant
